task.title: Post-bulk-load e2e parallel contention: ~30 tests flake at 9 workers, all pass solo
task.description: Filed from the P6-060 session (2026-08-11), superseding that task's premise. Measured after the full-catalog bulk load (116,695 printings vs the 2,976 POC subset the suite grew up on): full-suite runs at the default 9 workers fail ~25-30 tests with a DIFFERENT overlapping subset each run (baseline 229/259, post-helper 230/259), every sampled failure passes at --workers=1 (catalog.spec 27/27 solo), and the four historically-named hydration-click sites are not among the failures — the dominant class is now shared-dev-server contention on 40x heavier data, not unhydrated islands. The P6-060 helper (shipped) is the right convention for island clicks but cannot reach this class. Decide and implement the parallel policy: candidate levers are a lower default worker count (measure 4 first), per-worker data isolation, server capacity for the dev harness (release-profile server for e2e?), and/or targeted timeout raises. Acceptance: three consecutive full-suite runs at the chosen parallelism with zero contention-class failures, and the e2e-suite skill updated to the new policy with measured numbers. Until then --workers=1 remains the documented full-pass mode. Specs: specs/ui-work-loop.md (P6-060 Findings entry has the full evidence).
